recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current build-scope source already reflects the published FHIR-20770 decision, and the duplicate FHIR-32763 does not require additional source edits.
issue_request: FHIR-20770 was Published/Persuasive and asked to add CodeableConcept as a Communication payload content choice for machine-generated communications. The final resolution also added the same choice to CommunicationRequest.payload.content and clarified that contentCodeableConcept is the communicated content rather than metadata about the content.
initial_application: GF#20770 commits f7c3c1d and 8b4d465 applied the issue in R5 by adding CodeableConcept to Communication.payload.content and CommunicationRequest.payload.content, removing string from those choice lists, updating comments, and changing examples from contentString to contentCodeableConcept.text. The later source rework preserved the change in current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: FHIR-32763 later requested the CommunicationRequest half of the same payload choice and was resolved as a duplicate of FHIR-20770. Patient Care minutes in August 2023 list the duplicate disposition. Current source/fhir.ini lists Communication and CommunicationRequest as active resources in the build.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current Communication and CommunicationRequest StructureDefinition XML both include Attachment, Reference(Resource), and CodeableConcept for payload.content[x], include the FHIR-20770 explanatory comment, and no contentString or string payload type remains under the Communication or CommunicationRequest source folders.

related_jiras.note: Later CommunicationRequest-specific request resolved as duplicate of FHIR-20770 after the R5 source already supported CodeableConcept.
